description: This PHP script manages adding test case scripts within the TestLink project, handling user actions such as creating scripts, navigating project repositories, branches, and commits, and integrating with the TestLink backend and code tracker systems.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class representing test case management in TestLink, used here to access custom field linked information.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Class managing code tracker integration, used to get the interface object for code repository interactions.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Utility class for database table interactions, used to get DB table names.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for Smarty templates in TestLink.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class used for input parameter validation and sanitization.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class used to retrieve project details, including code tracker settings.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User class used for permission checks.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment parameters, request args, session variables, and related objects.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves code tracker interface object and configuration based on project settings.

methods.name: write_testcase_script
methods.description: Inserts or updates a link between test case version and code repository content in the database.

methods.name: write_cfield_testscript
methods.description: Updates custom field value for a test case version, if permitted.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to modify test cases.
